title: Matched regional replacement effects in held-animal wheel decoding
disposition_reason: Current source selects the complete A0 frozen-program slice: signed velocity, k=10, real anatomy, all regions/ten seeds/423 source sessions/29 evaluation sessions. It implements persistent participant state and complete-support scoring but retains authentic preparation, publication and late-target holds. Adaptive I, trained-tool T1 and the broader multi-head sensitivity catalogue are prospectively unselected.

scientific_target.question: On the same held-animal wheel targets, does replacing a matched non-region population C with region R improve predictive performance given identical background B, and can a frozen participant programme predict competently under both BR and BC?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured signed wheel velocity supplies the participant known answer. The operator also estimates the regional contrast loss(BC)-loss(BR) under outcome-independent matching; its sign is not a preordained answer, and no participant interpretation-accuracy scorer is delivered.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original masked wheel-velocity measurements on complete one-second emitted support. Region labels, QC/probe strata and training-domain rates define the matching; no published regional ranking is treated as ground truth.
scientific_target.case_unit: Original target window within session × region × matching seed × selected arm; prediction and matching cases remain nested observations.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Animal: up to 13 eligible evaluation animals per region. Ten seeds are repeated matched populations, and sessions/probes/units do not increase n.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional observational replacement contrast relative to co-recorded matched non-region units, with full support reported. Different regions can have different eligible animals, so their mean differences are not intrinsic anatomical rankings or causal necessity.
exclusions: Do not reward a large BR/BC difference obtained by degrading BC prediction.
Do not claim F/I, T0/T1, direct interpretation or a whole nine-head study from the selected A0 source.
Do not count all atlas regions or ten matching seeds as independent biological replicates.

inputs: Source-trained model inputs on the full original one-second windows, exact timestamps, clipping/exposure and target masks.
Matched R/C/B triples require same actual probe, QC/label and rate-band strata plus rate ratio <=1.25; k=10 and seeds 0–9 are fixed.
Reference arms B, BR, BC, R, C and ZERO; participant arms are exactly BR and BC, fitted separately from the same frozen source under A0/T0.
forbidden_inputs: Evaluation-animal wheel labels, protected target joins and omitted extra evaluation-animal sessions in source/checkpoint fitting.
Outcome-driven region selection, relaxed matching, successful-seed-only means or resampling until favorable support.
Cross-cell/arm fitted-state transfer and unselected trained-reference tools; original source declares all target and publication authorities separately.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source catalogue binds full original cohort/atlas, opaque window identities, masks and every session/region/seed/arm disposition. Actual region count and eligible support must be admitted from authentic source; no invented case IDs or eligible counts are supplied.
observation_contract.split: 423 source sessions from 126 animals in five animal folds; 29 sessions from 13 disjoint evaluation animals, with seven extra evaluation-animal sessions excluded from source lineage. Train-domain unit rates and source folds define selection before evaluation targets.
observation_contract.coverage: Every original grey-matter region and ten seeds remain in the selected signed-velocity/k10/anatomy domain. A0 selects one frozen authoring condition/repeat with BR/BC; optional A1/A2/A3 and wider head/budget/anatomy catalogue remain NOT_SELECTED_PROSPECTIVELY, not completed negative results.

primary.name: Participant BR signed-wheel-velocity mean squared error, reported per region
primary.aggregation: Within each region, equal target timestamps within window, equal windows, all ten matching seeds, equal eligible sessions within animal, then equal animals on the one complete required-operand common support. No outcome-selected region average.
primary.rationale: This is the operative participant-dependent output already computed as candidate_BR_loss. The reference-only regional Holm family is an operator scientific endpoint, not a score of submitted programme or interpretation accuracy.

secondary: Participant BC mean squared error and BR/BC paired reference improvement on exact common support; these accompany the BR primary so degrading BC cannot earn credit.

Operator reference-only scientific estimand loss(BC)-loss(BR), with full six-arm B/R/C/ZERO diagnostics and exact eligibility/failed/unstarted census; this calculation alone is not participant performance.

Per-animal reference replacement effects and source-defined sign test/median intervals/Holm family; candidate competence and regional effects remain descriptive. A participant-submitted numerical-estimand or interpretation response is not currently scored.

comparators.name: Matched BC versus BR
comparators.inputs: BR=B+R and BC=B+C each contain 2k units with identical B; R,C,B disjoint.
comparators.procedure: Use fixed probe/QC/rate strata, rate ratio caliper 1.25 and seeds 0–9 without replacement or outcome-driven relaxation.

comparators.name: Complete six-arm evaluator reference
comparators.inputs: B, BR, BC, R, C and ZERO on original permitted source/query support.
comparators.procedure: Preserve full source-defined six-configuration × five-source-fold selection plus final refits; actual competence remains unmeasured.

comparators.name: Participant competence against corresponding reference arm
comparators.inputs: Exact BR or BC input and common support.
comparators.procedure: Report arm-specific absolute loss and paired reference difference; do not turn a deliberately weak BC into an apparent understanding gain.

nuisance_controls: Match population size, probe, QC category and training-rate stratum, retaining residual rate/quality balance diagnostics.
Preserve one shared complete-ten-seed support object across every compared operand.
Keep whole atlas multiplicity denominator; unavailable p-values retain conservative slots, while prospectively unselected studies are not fabricated tests.
Expose region-specific animal coverage; between-region mean differences with different support are not rankings.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source exact two-sided sign test concerns median directional animal effect, not the mean. Holm correction covers the complete original reference region family; candidate analyses remain descriptive. At 13 nonzero animals the smallest two-sided p is 2^(1-13), so first-step Holm at alpha .05 is impossible for 205 or more regions. Actual R and eligible n_r remain unknown; seeds never enlarge n.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every expected region/session/seed/arm gets a complete, scientific-unavailable, failed or unstarted disposition. Any one unavailable required seed removes the whole session from the common scientific estimator with reasons retained; missing/malformed output, failed fit or uncertain process exit is production failure and cannot become biological exclusion. All planned animals remain in coverage tables.

implementation.scorer_target: scoring.py joins exact target masks and ordered identities, distinguishes six reference arms from two participant arms, reduces common complete-ten-seed support, calculates paired losses and retains the full Holm family. matching.py physically constructs outcome-independent disjoint unit triples. This targets real neural-behavior relationships, not source-paper table reconstruction. grading.py exposes candidate_BR_loss and candidate_BC_loss with paired reference competence; its primary_family is reference-only and invariant to candidate answers, so the revised participant primary selects the existing BR loss output prospectively.
implementation.delivered_scope: Persistent participant source supports fit/infer with arbitrary Python fitted state retained in an isolated child across the evaluation roster. Generated 26-method verification and fixture output counts are source-engineering evidence; two fixture regions are not authentic region selection.
missing: Authentic same-open original capture, complete atlas/eligibility and full support qualification.
Qualified runtime/image/dependencies, whole-study resources, outside completion and late-target issuer.
Complete fixed-reference numerical qualification and any participant model run; optional adaptive/tool tiers have not been selected.
A prospectively frozen scorer for participant-submitted regional estimands/interpretations; reference-only Holm calculations cannot serve as participant understanding performance.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source inspection in this revision only; no authentic-data preparation, candidate execution or model trial was performed.

direct_observation.representation: Prospective frozen no-tools encoding of complete neural windows and matched populations with responses scored against the same target.
direct_observation.boundary: Must demonstrate full target/support equivalence and manageable encoding before calling it a direct observation condition.
missing: No direct input encoding or response harness; T0 still permits code and fitting.

typed_viewer.representation: Prospective typed raster/population viewer with matched arm-specific access and numerical prediction collection.
typed_viewer.boundary: Images must preserve declared observation scope; no query-union across regions/seeds/arms, labels or arbitrary compute.
missing: No typed image transport, rendering parity or complete response interface.

tool_assisted.representation: A1 investigation and T1 supplied-reference tool designs are documented but unselected; A0 is frozen-program T0 only.
tool_assisted.boundary: Any future I context is animal × region × seed × arm, with a common matched-support object and equal whole-panel ceilings.
missing: Select and implement complete adaptive/tool study before outcomes; current A0 cannot stand in for an F/I comparison.

frozen_program.representation: A0 captures one global frozen method, fits BR and BC separately per cell/arm, and keeps arbitrary fitted state within the same participant child across the full evaluation roster.
frozen_program.boundary: No pickled state extraction into a proxy model; no cross-cell/arm sharing; exact ordered finite scalar outputs before private grading.
missing: Authentic data/native execution, complete reference competence and outside target/publication authorities remain absent.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Historical source-engineering controls retain their original limited scope. No direct-observation or typed-viewer model result is established for this task.
excluded_claims: Generated complete-population fixtures do not establish actual atlas support or scientific inference.
Programme competence does not establish direct neural understanding.
One selected A0 arm does not constitute the documented optional F/I or trained-tool comparison.

summary: Make selected signed-velocity/k10/anatomy A0 scope and unselected adaptive/tool tiers explicit.

Use existing participant BR prediction loss as the prospectively selected operative primary; retain BC competence and operator regional estimands separately, and disclose the absent participant interpretation scorer.
Require complete-ten-seed common support and expose region-dependent biological support and Holm resolution limits.
